question: Which cost centers were over budget in Q1 2025, and by how much?

expect.reference_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT cost_center_id, SUM(amount_usd) actual FROM gl_entries WHERE period IN ('2025-01','2025-02','2025-03') GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT cost_center_id, SUM(budget_usd) budget FROM budgets WHERE period IN ('2025-01','2025-02','2025-03') GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.name, a.actual - b.budget FROM a JOIN b ON a.cost_center_id = b.cost_center_id JOIN cost_centers c ON c.cost_center_id = a.cost_center_id WHERE a.actual > b.budget

fake_plans.intent: Cost centers whose Q1 actual spend exceeded Q1 budget, with the variance
fake_plans.sql: SELECT c.name AS cost_center, (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM gl_entries g WHERE g.cost_center_id = c.cost_center_id AND g.period BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03') - (SELECT SUM(budget_usd) FROM budgets b WHERE b.cost_center_id = c.cost_center_id AND b.period BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03') AS variance_usd FROM cost_centers c WHERE variance_usd > 0 ORDER BY variance_usd DESC
assumptions: variance = actual - budget, positive means over budget
